summary.text: Abdelnasser Rashid is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 21st District, serving since January 2023, according to the Illinois General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: His legislature biography says he holds a Bachelor of Arts from Harvard University and an MBA in finance and economics from the University of Chicago Booth School of Business.
The biography says he was first elected in 2022, was appointed to co-chair Illinois' AI Task Force, and lives in Bridgeview.
